releaseNotes: v1.0.8: Official Portal Stability & Complete CSP Compliance. Eliminates official captive portal auto-closing loop on user-opened tabs by isolating tab lifecycle management strictly to automated background bootstrap instances. Resolves all browser Content Security Policy (CSP) inline script and javascript: URL violations through pure DOM event capturing, guards against injection on internal browser contexts, and preserves session recovery status.
updateInstructions: Double-click Update-Windows.bat (Windows) or Update-Mac.command (Mac), then reload on edge://extensions or chrome://extensions.
